title: Ranking | Unique Capital Named Top-10 FA for Go-Global by EqualOcean (2023)
summary: EqualOcean’s 2023 GoGlobal Forum of 100 (GGF2023) ran 7–8 December 2023 at the Renaissance Shanghai Zhongshan Park Hotel. GGF is among the most influential go-global gatherings — entrepreneurs, founders, academics, investors, diplomats, and international-organization leaders
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Ranking · December 11, 2023 · EqualOcean GGF2023

EqualOcean’s 2023 GoGlobal Forum of 100 (GGF2023) ran 7–8 December 2023 at the Renaissance Shanghai Zhongshan Park Hotel. GGF is among the most influential go-global gatherings — entrepreneurs, founders, academics, investors, diplomats, and international-organization leaders debating new-globalization opportunities for Chinese firms.

EqualOcean reviewed a year of go-global investment, multi-sourced and screened deals, and scored candidates over two months of preliminary, secondary, and final rounds with analysts, industry experts, and external juries. Unique Capital won “2023 Top-10 FA Institution in Go-Global” for professional service capability and annual performance.

What Unique Capital covers

As an industry investment bank focused on globalization and AI, Unique Capital studies go-global enterprise-service ecosystems across new marketing, new retail, and new experience — offering one-stop fundraising and commercialization advisory.

This year, with Unique Capital’s support, multiple partners entered AWS / Baidu AI Cloud accelerators; six partners reached the Top 30 of the 2023 Heima AI Innovation Contest, with Biyou Tech taking runner-up. Companies including Kuaizi Tech, FOSHO, QuickCEP, Okebeli, Lüsen, and Jingying Tech (CreativeFitting) raised fresh capital and accelerated global expansion.

Founder note

Founding partner Wu Wei: 2023 will be written into global capital-market chronicles — more Chinese firms “Going Global” or “Born to be global,” from product/brand export into capacity export, while generative AI gives domestic ToB SaaS a new push abroad. Firms should build globalization and AI foundations for cycle resilience. In 2024 Unique Capital will keep aiming to be China’s most specialized globalization × AI industry bank — thanks to every Unique Partner who walked the path with us.

2 CN images; attach on ingest. Type ranking per inventory.

— END —
